description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which specifies a contract for logging components that can output log data and pass it along a chain. It includes a single method, println, used to output log information with optional exception data.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface for logging components that can output log data and pass it along to other log nodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs a log message with the specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.
